title: Make vs n8n
description: Make vs n8n: n8n is our overall pick for Developer Tools teams — Make 4.3/5, n8n 4.4/5; Make from Free–$29/mo, n8n from Free – $20/mo

features.name: Free tier availability
features.tool1Detail: Make offers a free tier with essential features for getting started. Free tiers include core functionality with usage limits.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides a free tier for small teams. Freemium models reduce initial investment risk.

features.name: Entry-level pricing
features.tool1Detail: Make starts at Freemium (Free–$29/mo). This tier supports small teams with core features. See Developer Tools pricing guide.
features.tool2Detail: n8n begins at Freemium (Free – $20/mo). TCO should include per-user fees, storage overages, and premium add-ons.

features.name: Enterprise pricing
features.tool1Detail: Make offers custom enterprise pricing with SLA-backed support and advanced security. Includes audit logging and data residency.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides enterprise tiers with volume discounts. SSO, compliance certs, and custom SLAs included.

features.name: Annual discount
features.tool1Detail: Make offers 15-20% savings with annual billing. TCO cost reduction for committed teams with multi-year contract options.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides annual billing with 15-25% savings. SaaS pricing analysis confirms typical annual commitment benefits.

features.name: Free trial duration
features.tool1Detail: Make provides a 14-30 day free trial with access to all core features. This trial period allows teams to thoroughly evaluate the platform against their specific workflows, test integrations with existing tools, and assess overall performance before making a financial commitment. Many teams use this period to run parallel operations and validate migration paths.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers a similar trial duration with full feature access. We strongly recommend our structured evaluation checklist to maximize trial effectiveness, including checking integration compatibility, testing API endpoints, and evaluating performance under your typical workload conditions.

features.name: Contract flexibility
features.tool1Detail: Make offers month-to-month, annual, and multi-year contract options. Monthly billing provides flexibility for teams still evaluating fit, while annual contracts reduce per-unit costs. SaaS contract terms typically include usage-based scaling and add-on modules.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides flexible contract terms with monthly and annual options. Multi-year commitments often include additional discounts and waived implementation fees for enterprise customers.

features.name: Usage-based scaling
features.tool1Detail: Make scales pricing based on team size, storage, and feature tier. Usage-based pricing ensures you only pay for what you need, with automatic upgrades as your team grows. Industry benchmarks help forecast costs at scale.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers similar usage-based scaling with clear upgrade paths. TCO modeling should include expected growth over 12-24 months when comparing platforms.

features.name: User role management
features.tool1Detail: Make provides RBAC with customizable permission levels supporting complex hierarchies and compliance.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers role management with SCIM provisioning for SSO-based user lifecycle management.

features.name: Two-factor authentication
features.tool1Detail: Make supports 2FA via TOTP, SMS, and FIDO2 hardware keys. Zero-trust benefits from MFA enforcement.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides 2FA with authenticator apps and biometrics on mobile. Encryption combined with 2FA provides defense-in-depth.

features.name: Audit logging
features.tool1Detail: Make maintains audit trails for actions and changes. Compliance-ready exports support SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides activity logging with searchable history. SIEM integration enables centralized monitoring.

features.name: Mobile app
features.tool1Detail: Make offers native iOS and Android apps with push notifications and offline access for mobile workforce productivity.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides mobile apps. Remote team collaboration supported via mobile-optimized interfaces.

features.name: Search functionality
features.tool1Detail: Make features full-text search with filters. AI-powered search suggests relevant results based on usage patterns.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides search with filtering. Global search helps teams find information across workspaces.

features.name: Template library
features.tool1Detail: Make provides pre-built templates for common workflows. Custom templates support branding and standardization.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers template collections for industries. Workflow templates speed implementation.

features.name: Community ecosystem
features.tool1Detail: Make has a large community. Community contributions extend functionality via plugins and shared resources.
features.tool2Detail: n8n maintains growing community with user groups and forums.

features.name: Onboarding experience
features.tool1Detail: Make offers guided onboarding with tutorials and setup wizards. Self-paced learning accelerates proficiency.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides documentation, video tutorials, and live training. Knowledge base covers setup scenarios.

features.name: Multi-language support
features.tool1Detail: Make supports multiple languages with localized interfaces. International teams benefit from regional format support.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides multi-language with interface translations. i18n supports global collaboration.

features.name: Custom branding
features.tool1Detail: Make provides white-label options with custom domain and branding for client portals.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers branding customization with custom themes and domain config on business plans.

features.name: Bulk operations
features.tool1Detail: Make supports batch processing for data management. API-based bulk operations handle large datasets efficiently, with progress tracking and error reporting built into the workflow.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers bulk import/export in CSV and JSON formats. Scheduled bulk operations support automated data synchronization between systems.

features.name: Data portability
features.tool1Detail: Make provides full data export capabilities in multiple formats including JSON, CSV, and PDF. API-based data access ensures you maintain control of your information at all times. GDPR data portability requirements are fully supported.
features.tool2Detail: n8n supports data portability through export tools and API access. Migration in or out of the platform is designed to minimize friction for growing teams.

features.name: Offline mode
features.tool1Detail: Make provides offline functionality with automatic sync when connectivity is restored. This is critical for field teams, traveling professionals, and environments with unreliable internet access.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers limited offline capabilities with local caching of recent data. Mobile apps provide the most robust offline experience for on-the-go teams.

features.name: SSO/SAML
features.tool1Detail: Make supports SSO via SAML 2.0 with SCIM provisioning for AD sync.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers SSO on mid-tier plans with social login options.

features.name: Encryption at rest
features.tool1Detail: Make uses AES-256 encryption with CMEK on enterprise plans. Data residency controls included.
features.tool2Detail: n8n encrypts with AES-256 with auto key rotation. SOC 2 standards are met.

features.name: Encryption in transit
features.tool1Detail: Make enforces TLS 1.3 with perfect forward secrecy.
features.tool2Detail: n8n uses TLS with HTTPS-only API enforcement.

features.name: SOC 2 Type II
features.tool1Detail: Make maintains SOC 2 Type II with annual independent audits.
features.tool2Detail: n8n is SOC 2 certified with regular assessments.

features.name: GDPR compliance
features.tool1Detail: Make is GDPR compliant with DPA and EU data residency options.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides GDPR features with DPA and data portability.

features.name: HIPAA compliance
features.tool1Detail: Make has not independently verified HIPAA compliance — contact vendor for current status.
features.tool2Detail: n8n has not independently verified HIPAA compliance — contact vendor for current status.

features.name: Uptime SLA
features.tool1Detail: Make guarantees 99.9% uptime with SLA credits. Multi-region redundancy ensures business continuity.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers competitive SLA commitments with SOC 2 audited availability metrics.

features.name: Data residency
features.tool1Detail: Make data residency options — not independently verified; contact vendor
features.tool2Detail: n8n data residency options — not independently verified; contact vendor

features.name: Incident response
features.tool1Detail: Make maintains a documented incident response plan with notification timelines aligned to SOC 2 requirements. Security incidents are communicated within SLA-defined windows.
features.tool2Detail: n8n follows industry-standard incident response procedures with regular tabletop exercises and third-party penetration testing.

features.name: Vulnerability management
features.tool1Detail: Make runs continuous vulnerability scanning and maintains a responsible disclosure program. Third-party security audits are conducted quarterly with results available to enterprise customers.
features.tool2Detail: n8n performs regular security assessments with automated scanning and manual penetration testing by certified security researchers.

features.name: API access
features.tool1Detail: Make provides REST and GraphQL APIs with SDKs. Webhooks enable event-driven integrations.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers RESTful API. Automation platforms connect both for no-code workflows.

features.name: Native integrations
features.tool1Detail: Make integrates with Slack, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers API-first architecture for custom connector development.

features.name: Webhook support
features.tool1Detail: Make supports custom webhooks for event-driven workflows and real-time data sync.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides webhook triggers and actions for automation.

features.name: Auto workflow
features.tool1Detail: Make includes workflow automation for common tasks. Automation comparisons help choose complementary tools.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides automation with triggers and conditional logic for complex business processes.

features.name: Reporting and analytics
features.tool1Detail: Make offers custom dashboards and KPI tracking. Industry benchmarks contextualize metrics.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides reporting with visual analytics and export. ROI tracking demonstrates value.

features.name: Notification system
features.tool1Detail: Make provides customizable alerts and push, email, and in-app notifications.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers notification controls with configurable triggers.

features.name: Customer support
features.tool1Detail: Make provides knowledge base, email, and chat. Premium tiers include SLA-backed support and account managers.
features.tool2Detail: n8n offers ticket support and help center. Zendesk integration enables unified ticketing.

features.name: Training resources
features.tool1Detail: Make offers webinars, documentation, and certification programs for team upskilling.
features.tool2Detail: n8n provides help center and video tutorials for self-paced learning.

features.name: Community support
features.tool1Detail: Make has large active community forums and user groups for peer support.
features.tool2Detail: n8n maintains growing community with meetups and events.
